note: Community postings serving Fisher Hill and White Plains. Reviewed before posting.

posts.title: Fisher Hill Association Spring Meeting
posts.summary: Monthly meeting of the Fisher Hill Association — neighborhood updates, the hospital expansion, and spring planning. All residents welcome.

posts.title: Fisher Hill Spring Cleanup Walk
posts.summary: Help clear litter, open walking paths, and prepare planting beds along the neighborhood greenway. Gloves and supplies provided.

posts.title: Highlands Rain Garden Workshop
posts.summary: Learn simple techniques for reducing stormwater runoff using native plants and small residential rain gardens.

posts.title: White Plains Emergency Preparedness Night
posts.summary: City staff discuss emergency alerts, cooling centers, severe-weather response, and household preparedness. Q&A to follow.

posts.title: Gedney Farms Historic Homes Walking Tour
posts.summary: A guided walking tour highlighting several historic homes and neighborhood landmarks within the Gedney Farms area.

posts.title: Mamaroneck Avenue Sidewalk Repairs — Public Notice
posts.summary: Sectional sidewalk repairs begin the week of June 8. Expect intermittent pedestrian detours along the east side of the avenue.
posts.source: City of White Plains Public Works

posts.title: North Street Community Picnic & Music Evening
posts.summary: Bring blankets and picnic dinners for live acoustic music and family activities. Open lawn space for kids.

posts.title: Post Road Parking Garage — Construction Update
posts.location: East Post Road & White Plains Hospital
posts.summary: Steel work on the new East Post Road garage continues through summer. Expect lane shifts on Post Road and Longview Avenue during weekday hours.

posts.title: Safe Streets Bicycle Visibility Clinic
posts.summary: Free bicycle light installation, helmet-fitting guidance, and visibility tips for riders of all ages.

posts.title: Walworth Avenue Block Party
posts.summary: Fisher Hill's annual block party returns — food, music, a kids' zone, and a meet-your-neighbors table. Street closed to traffic.
